label: Ground G22
qualification: Source registration/evidence available where listed; inspect source before claiming exact 3D reconstruction

surface.qualification: Coarse source-masked own-cell two-step receiving proxy. The existing editor rule declares rise2/lift128 and support at the owner cell; current per-view pivot128208 and scale1 are retained. The G12 own-cell boundary convention supplies coarse face extent X/Z[-.5,.5] and upper H2. Source pixels beyond that nominal boundary use explicit closest-plane extensions and remain counted; no clipping or source warp. These extensions, rock thickness, cap width and fine relief are not measured vendor geometry. Receiver planes do not author blocking volume or a gameplay solid. G22 opaque dark recess remains source material; its depth is the coarse receiving face only. Actual recess depth, arch wall thickness and passability are unresolved. True source alpha gaps stay absent; no portal transparency is invented.
